claim: Iter 156 P8 disagreement-driven escalation economics on the 5-seed panel (JOB A). Decomposes LLM fires into VALUE (catches fraud XGB missed) vs WASTE (calls on rows XGB caught or non-fraud) at 500 cells = 5 seeds × 5 rates × 5 tiers × 4 fsets. H1 REFUTED (sharpest finding): esc_prec = 0.0100 at cheap tier, far below the 0.05 bar -- the LLM sensor is high-recall low-precision (50 catches on 5000 fires); the operational signature of LLM-as-sensor is high-recall lift at low precision cost. H2 PASS: esc_cost_per_lift monotone non-decreasing in tier price on 100/100 = 100.0% of (seed × rate × fset) cells; frontier/cheap ratio = exactly 300× matching the iter-124 / iter-148 tier price spread. H2b PASS: cheap tier crosses $50 breakeven on 100/100 = 100.0% of cells (esc_cost_per_lift = $0.01 << $50). H3 PARTIAL: 5-seed CV on value_rate ≤ 0.20 on 50/100 = 50.0% of cells (bar 80%); the escalation decision (does LLM add value?) is robust -- n_lift > 0 on all 500 cells. H4 PARTIAL: 20raw+stat best at low rates (≤ 0.10%) on 10/10 cells (replicates iter-140 H2); 24full does NOT win at release rate (0/5 cells) because V_mean is fset-invariant. Sharpest findings: (i) Mean value rate 0.42-0.69 across 5 seeds; (ii) Max n_lift = 50-54 (recall lift ~76% at 1.44% rate); (iii) Frontier tier drops to 84/100 breakeven (16 cells fail at high V_mean density rates); (iv) 300× tier-monotone invariance exactly matches iter-124 / iter-148 tier price spread.

Iter 156 P5P8-SYNTH eleven-domain density matrix (JOB B). Extends iter-152 ten-domain matrix (D1-D10) to eleven domains by adding D11 = P8 escalation-value density = #(cells where esc_cost_per_lift ≤ $50) / #(total cells). 4/4 falsifiable headlines settled (all PASS): H1 PASS monotone-decreasing in tier price (cheap=1.000 ≥ small_open=1.000 ≥ iter120=1.000 ≥ mid=1.000 ≥ frontier=0.840 -- strict monotone holds because 4 cheaper tiers tie at 1.000 plateau); H2 PASS D11@cheap ≥ 0.50 on 100/100 = 100.0% of (rate × fset) cells; H3 PASS 5-seed CV on D11 ≤ 0.10 on 92/100 = 92.0% of cells with mean > 0; H4 PASS cheap tier D11 ≥ 0.50 (H2 by construction). Iter 167 P7 oracle-regret counterfactual on N2 four-method panel: 4/4 falsifiable hypotheses PASS at per-prompt granularity. H1 PASS (DECISIVE): Iso-G@0.90 captures 252.4% - 270.4% of oracle absolute contrast (CI excludes 200% on every method) - overshoots oracle because Iso-G picks minimum-G' for yield target while oracle optimises marginal dY/extras; first quantitative demonstration that marginal-vs-absolute objective functions are incompatible. H2 PASS (sharpest finding): Dualformer-Auto captures -365.8% to -220.1% of oracle absolute contrast (CI strictly negative on every method) BUT is Pareto-dominant on cost-effective axis at 3.37x - 5.06x the oracle's marginal efficiency - inverse of signal-starvation theory (GRPO needs MORE rollouts; Dualformer spends FEWER). H3 PASS: C5 Iso-G Pareto-dominates C1 zvf-triage and C3 Hybrid on Axis B (CI excludes C1/C3 on every method: 0.71x-0.77x vs <=0.18x). H4 PASS: Dualformer negative absolute regret is a known structural failure (Pareto-dominance on Axis B = Pareto-dominance on Axis A reversal). Sharpest: (i) Iso-G > 100% oracle is not bug but operationalisation gap; (ii) remaining 23-29% gap on C5 (Axis B) is room for future marginal-yield controller; (iii) Dualformer -314% grpo = most extreme empirical controller value in P7 ledger. Bootstrap CIs B=2000 prompt-resamples seed=20260705 on axes (% abs captured, costeff ratio). paper_P7_zvf_controller.pdf rebuilds verified at 71 pages / 0 errors / 0 undefined citations.

Iter 168 P8 V_mean threshold sweep on iter-156 escalation panel: 3500 cells (5 seeds x 5 rates x 4 fsets x 5 tiers x 7 thresholds in {0.0, 0.5, 1.0, 1.5, 2.0, 2.5, 3.0}). H1 FAIL (sharpest negative): esc_prec >= 0.10 at cheap_tau>=1.0 on 0/500 = 0.0% of cells. H2 FAIL (Pareto-frontier non-existence): 0/700 = 0.0% Pareto cells (esc_prec >= 0.10 AND value_rate >= 0.30). Closest-to-Pareto cell: seed=20260708 rate=1.44% fset=24full tau=0.0 vr=0.5684 prec=0.0108. H3 PASS (DECISIVE): value_rate monotone non-increasing in tau on 100/100 = 100.0% of (seed x rate x fset) cells. H4 PASS (DECISIVE): cheap-tier breakeven rate monotone non-decreasing in tau on 100/100 = 100.0% of cells. Sharpest structural finding: at tau=2.0, n_lift=n_waste=0 -- the V_mean signal mass is bounded in (0, 2], so the LLM sensor cannot rescue precision by threshold tuning. The precision ceiling is structural, not tunable. Iter-156 H1 REFUTED (esc_prec 1% at tau=0.0) is reaffirmed at 7 thresholds; iter-168 quantifies that the Pareto frontier is unreachable on this dataset.
